description: List support conversations (tickets) in the shared inbox, with rich filters. Filter by state, channel_id, folder_id, tag_name, assigned, starred, or keywords; paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: conversations(filter: ConversationFilter).

after.description: Relay pagination cursor — pass the previous page's `endCursor` to get the next page.

assigned.description: If set, filter to assigned (true) or unassigned (false) conversations.

channel_id.description: Filter to a single channel (mailbox) id.

first.description: How many records to return (Relay pagination `first`).

folder_id.description: Filter to a single folder id.

starred.description: If set, filter to starred (true) or unstarred (false) conversations.

tag_name.description: Filter to conversations carrying this tag name.

name: groove_list_conversations
title: List conversations
